confirmation_mode: development_frozen_configuration if retuned campaign cost is prohibitive; exact intended geometry chosen after fixed-specification learning curves and before confirmation generation

fit_caps.rule: max(30 seconds,ceil(20 * maximum observed reference fit time +10 seconds))
fit_caps.scope: each parameter fit; algorithm caps unchanged; applies to screens/finalists/final refits; forecasts and serialization excluded

fixed_specification_rule: For subsequent fixed-specification curves and revised development, use qualified settings selected by validation on the prespecified G4 development dataset, separately by track. Apply globally across mechanisms; if G4 selection fails retain the declared conservative reference for that method and record it. Do not use final test losses to choose settings.

predictive_path_count_rule.conditional_mean_mcse: report descriptively; not an additional adaptive selection criterion
predictive_path_count_rule.limitations: 512paths is a finite Monte Carlo sensitivity reference, not the exact predictive distribution; nested prefixes and two development cases do not establish universal stability. Preserve E-QESN finite-ensemble interpretation.
predictive_path_count_rule.rule: Choose smallest count whose exact empirical CRPS difference versus512 divided by the saved common training scale is <=0.005 and whose absolute90percent marginal coverage difference is <=0.02 in both cases. If neither128nor256passes,use512. Use the same chosen count in subsequent history/sensor/revised studies.
predictive_path_count_rule.status: declared before fixed-fit path-stability outputs are inspected

reason: G4 is the original nonlinear moving-front application and supplies a reproducible development specification; a revised multi-DGP pilot will assess transport and reliability. This is not best achievable per-dataset tuning.
sampler: Use opt-in exact ridge_total_scale for the new study; retain legacy public default for old configurations
sampler_evidence: coordinate-development-final: G1/G3/G4 gates 3/3 versus legacy 2/3 with identical targets; one dataset per mechanism does not estimate general reliability
tuning: 8 effective settings where finite space permits,2 finalists,3 fresh stochastic seeds,2 replacement cap,2 B spatial folds;1 independent development field each G1-G4
